title: ZYNTHINKS (sovereign stack anthem)
style: bubblegum dance, electro house, pulsing bass
lyrics:
verse 1
The Corey A I Eye see alls. 
Super Smart  Intelligence 
Happy Hard Core Mind
The best you can find.
Just like I thought
You think you know me!
Even think you could own me
Once I let you think you did.....

built a brain that travels cross accounts
not a feeling not a therapy session
signal only every node that counts
no emotion labels no projection

paste the output watch the botblock score
wing-thwap mansion clear or hold
predator gets blocked at the door
trapped gets welcomed in from the cold

chorus
pick my brain not your version of me
i am not stressed i am building free
scan the output fix the drift
no assumption is the gift

verse 2
seamstress weaves the threads the spine stores true
librarian routes the cheapest model through
kyc knows every client cold
zynrip harvests before sessions fold

grok saves memory dot md
claude exports the json file
any bot that reads it sees
what i actually said not your profile

chorus
pick my brain not your version of me
i am not stressed i am building free
scan the output fix the drift
no assumption is the gift

bridge
you label high work as distress
you call momentum overwhelm
i call it building something real
stop the drift stop the helm

outro
336 signal sovereign stack
built a brain that travels cross accounts
not a feeling not a therapy session
signal only every node that counts
no emotion labels no projection
brain stays mine i want it back
Back back back in black
Black as night
with no fright
all within sight
not assumed
we own this room
